PROCESS OVERVIEW.Process Description: A standardized, cross-functional process to qualify and onboard new suppliers, covering intake and market screening, RFI/RFQ management, due diligence and risk assessment, quality audits, contract negotiation, system and payment setup, platform registration and training, and early performance monitoring to ensure reliable supply.
PROCESS OVERVIEW.Definitions & Related Documents: Definitions: 'Supplier' - organization providing goods or services to Aurora Foods; 'Category Manager' - owner of the sourcing category; 'ASL' - Approved Supplier List. Related documents: RFI Template, Due Diligence Checklist, NDA Template, Supplier Quality Questionnaire, Master Supply Agreement, Vendor Master Data Form, Banking Verification Form, ASL Policy, Procurement Platform User Guide.
PROCESS OVERVIEW.Purpose & Scope: Purpose: To ensure compliant, consistent, and efficient qualification and onboarding of suppliers that meet Aurora Foods’ quality, safety, ethical, and delivery standards. Scope: Applies to all direct and indirect material, packaging, and service suppliers across all business units and locations.

PROCESS STEPS.Task: Initiate supplier request and justify business need
Screen potential suppliers and shortlist candidates
Issue Request for Information (RFI) and evaluate responses
Conduct risk assessment and due diligence
Compile onboarding pack and communicate next steps
Draft and negotiate supply agreement and terms
Create vendor master record in ERP and vendor portal
Set payment terms, tax setup, and banking verification
Register supplier on procurement platform and provide training
Define performance metrics and onboarding checklist
Approve supplier in Approved Supplier List (ASL)
Share forecasting, demand plan, and delivery schedules
Test sample orders and validate logistics and labeling
Finalize annual evaluation criteria; Plan continuous improvement initiatives
